name.ja: 30MM ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON ARQUEBUS CORPORATION VP-40S ロックスミス
name.en: 30MM ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON ARQUEBUS CORPORATION VP-40S LOCKSMITH

ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、V.Ⅰフロイトが操る「ロックスミス」が登場！
■頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に「アセンブル」をプラモデルで楽しめる。
■「Vvc-770LB」のチャージ攻撃再現パーツが付属。
■V.Ⅰフロイトのマーキングをテトロンシールで再現。
en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.
Based on the series' key concepts of "Simple Assembly " and " Custom Play," the " Rocksmith" operated by V.I. Freud is now available!
• The head, core, arms, and legs each use the same structure as the series, allowing you to enjoy "assembling" the plastic model just like in the game.
• Weapons include "RF-024 TURNER ", " Vvc-770LB ", " SB-033M MORLEY " and " Vvc-700LD".
• "Vvc-770LB" charge attack reproduction parts are included.
• Reproduce V.I Freud's marking with Tetron Seal.
